listing.name: More Loot
listing.summary: Adds new unique items to scavenge from abandoned space stations, planet ruins, salvage fields, and derelict ships.
listing.aiSummary: Adds new unique items to scavenge from abandoned space stations, planet ruins, salvage fields, and derelict ships.

description:
A simple mod which add new items to scavenge on abandoned space stations and planet ruins. Different stations and size ruins reward different items. The items have the only practical purpose of be sold for extra cash.

Download:

https://www.mediafire.com/file/ro4on3xkih5ybco/More_Loot_1.2.rar/file

Alternative version:

https://www.mediafire.com/file/8foge9ur49ekiyh/More_Loot_1.2_Alt.rar/file

Quote

I made a new and alternative version with some extra items you can find, but this time on salvage fields, derelict ships and post battle salvage. It pollutes the stardard loot pool of those entities but the probability of finding the items it's low enought that in practice the alterarion isn't noticeable.

The main reason I made it alternative to the main version is because the new items also drops in derelict and remnant fleets which contextually doesn't have sense. Still the new items compensate it for me so I choosed to share the new version. Personally when I find an item added by this mod on a nonhuman fleet I just leave it, as if had not dropped.

Example of a mining station scavenge operation:

Many of the new items can be considered to be redundant because Starsector already has item categories where they can form part like "ore", "organics" or "luxury items". But I think that finding specific and unique items is way more exciting, rewarding and fun than just finding a bunch of generic refined metals.

This mod is incompatible with Ashes of The Domain Vaults of Knowledge and any other that modifies the same entries. Although compatibility can be easily achieved by combining the entries added by AoTD-VoK and my mod, in both mods, in the file "salvage_entity_gen_data", rows "station_research/mining/habitat_remnant", column "drop_random".

Here

you can download the files with the entries combited, to make it more easy for you. Treat that archive like an example and don't just drag and drop the files to your mod directory because it can be outdated.

I made a new and alternative version with some extra items you can find, but this time on salvage fields, derelict ships and post battle salvage. It pollutes the stardard loot pool of those entities but the probability of finding the items it's low enought that in practice the alterarion isn't noticeable.

The main reason I made it alternative to the main version is because the new items also drops in derelict and remnant fleets which contextually doesn't have sense. Still the new items compensate it for me so I choosed to share the new version. Personally when I find an item added by this mod on a nonhuman fleet I just leave it, as if had not dropped.

Many of the new items can be considered to be redundant because Starsector already has item categories where they can form part like "ore", "organics" or "luxury items". But I think that finding specific and unique items is way more exciting, rewarding and fun than just finding a bunch of generic refined metals.
